title: GRP: Goal-Reversed Prompting for Zero-Shot Evaluation with LLMs

bias_targets.methodology: Assessing the LLM-based judge twice by swapping the order of the response pairs (A vs B, then B vs A) to ensure the judge consistently identifies the better or worse response regardless of presentation order.

Conducting an ablation study where LLMs evaluate response pairs generated by themselves (e.g., using Claude-3.5-Sonnet to generate responses and evaluate them) to observe pronounced bias and deterioration in evaluation outcomes.
